name: aasist-tk
trained_on: ASVspoof 2019 LA train + Turkmen set (Common Voice and broadcast speech; 9 seen generators), fine-tuned from the official AASIST weights (clovaai/aasist, MIT)

extra.calibrated_on: Turkmen dev + ASVspoof 2019 LA dev subset
extra.evaluated_on: Turkmen test (incl. 2 unseen generators) and ASVspoof 2019 LA eval
extra.selection: mean(Turkmen dev EER, ASVspoof LA dev EER); no test-based checkpoint or threshold selection
extra.note: 15 continuation epochs from run 1 (6 epochs); checkpoint selected at continuation epoch 13. Dev-fitted temperature/thresholds unchanged after observing test results. Seed reused from run 1.
extra.max_verdict_reason: Uncapped real Turkmen false-fake rate is 6.31% (14.05% for quiet speech), above the 5% target. Fake-as-real rate also increased from 14.40% to 18.19%; held-out Vocos remains weak. The suspicious cap and provisional flag stay.
